title: Dame Joan Bakewell, Jamie Oliver and Alan Bennett
author: Ian Anstice / The Library Campaign

editorial.text: 400 libraries (310 buildings and 90 mobiles) currently under threat or closed/left council control since 1/4/11 out of c.4612 in the UK, complete list below. Librarian professional body CILIP forecasts 600 libraries under threat (inc. 20% of English libraries). The Public Libraries News figure is obtained from counting up all reports about public libraries in the media each day.
